description: The originality and fit check of a press release, sponsored article or guest post before ordering: originality (how much matches pages already published), content rules (illegal content, attacks on or misrepresentation of named third parties) and, with item_id, the fit with that newswire package or site (word count, links, language, excluded topics), with exact fixes. Fit problems are warnings; a content rules flag sends the item to a person. Use this when a text is ready and the person wants to know whether it suits the chosen distribution. Do not use for writing the text. Side effects: the text is sent to our originality service; each check counts toward the account's monthly allowance of checks (the answer says how many are left); no credits move.

item_id.description: Optional: a published item, to check the fit with its rules. Example: "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f7b-9c2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f"

text.description: The full press release or article. Example: "Northwind Studio opens its Lisbon office. ..."

name: check_originality_and_fit
title: Check originality and fit
